h1:
Where to Stay in Mukdahan?
10 Mekong-Side Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Ten Mukdahan hotels across every budget — 4-star riverside hotels with Mekong and Lao-bank views, a town hotel with a rooftop pool, down to value rooms in the town centre and budget stays near the Friendship Bridge 2 crossing. Covering the Indochina Market riverside, the town centre, and the road up to Friendship Bridge 2. Starting from around ฿350–1,400/night.
introH2: 🌅 Why does choosing the right area in Mukdahan matter?
introHtml: Mukdahan is a Mekong border town, and its charm is the river view across to the Lao town of Savannakhet on the far bank, plus its role as a gateway into Laos via Friendship Bridge 2. Accommodation splits into three areas with different feels — the Indochina Market riverside is the riverfront strip in the town centre, where you open the curtains to the Mekong and can walk to the Indochina Market and the embankment promenade. The town centre has hotels within walking distance of markets, restaurants, and the riverfront without paying for a riverfront room. And the road up to Friendship Bridge 2 suits drivers who want to stop overnight or cross the border into Savannakhet the next morning. This guide brings together 10 Mukdahan hotels we've picked from real guest reviews across every tier — from 4-star riverside down to budget rooms in the low hundreds — with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Mukdahan has no metro; the town is compact, and driving yourself, Grab, or local taxis are the easiest way around — and many hotels have free parking. The main areas in this guide: Indochina Market Riverside — the Mekong promenade, the Indochina Market, Wat Si Mongkhon Tai, and Lao/Vietnamese/Chinese imported goods · Town Centre — the Mukdahan Tower (Ho Kaew), the clock tower, in-town markets, Big C, all within reach of the river · Friendship Bridge 2 area — the border checkpoint to Savannakhet and the bypass road, around 7–10 minutes by car from the riverfront.

entries.name: Hotel de Ladda
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Riverside, Samran Chai Khong Rd · walk to Indochina Market
entries.addr: 77 Samran Chai Khong Tai Rd, Si Bun Ruang, Mueang Mukdahan
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.4 — Hotel de Ladda is a 4-star Mekong riverside hotel where you open the balcony to the river and the Lao bank in full view. Opened in 2016 with 47 rooms, what guests love is the floor-to-ceiling windows, the marble bathrooms with both a tub and a rain shower, and the pool and gym that look out over the river. It's a few minutes' walk to the Indochina Market and the embankment, and TripAdvisor ranks it #2 in Mukdahan.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: confirm a River View room or Premier Corner Suite at booking, since not every room sees the river, and ask for a higher floor as the walls are on the thin side.
pros: Rooms with Mekong-view balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows
Marble bathrooms with both a tub and a strong rain shower
Pool and gym overlook the river; walk to the Indochina Market
Free private parking, handy if you're driving yourself
cons: Walls are on the thin side; you can hear neighbours when full
Some balconies have no table/chairs, and not all rooms see the river

entries.name: Hop Inn Mukdahan
entries.badge: 🧼 Top score & most reviewed, spotless rooms
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chayangkul Kor Rd · near Friendship Bridge 2
entries.storyHtml: The highest score and most reviews in this guide at 9.6 from 127 reviews — Hop Inn Mukdahan is a Hop Inn-chain budget hotel selling clean rooms, low prices, and a standard you can rely on. The single standard room is around 20 sqm in grey-and-white tones, with a big bed, a balcony, and a fridge; reviewers agree on the cleanliness. It sits on the bypass road near Friendship Bridge 2 with free parking, ideal for drivers stopping overnight or crossing the border.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a higher floor for a quieter room and a more open view. There's no breakfast, but restaurants, markets, and Lotus's / Robinson are a few minutes' drive away.
pros: Very clean rooms, identical standard across the board, comfy beds
Low prices, great value for an overnight before crossing the border
Free parking near Friendship Bridge 2, easy early departure
Friendly staff, 24-hour front desk
cons: No breakfast, no pool, limited extra services
Not on the river; you drive 7–10 minutes into town for the promenade

entries.name: Riverfront Hotel Mukdahan
entries.badge: 🛍️ Most reviewed, beside the Indochina Market
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Riverside, beside Indochina Market · walk to the embankment
entries.addr: 22 Samran Chai Khong Tai Rd, Si Bunrueang, Mueang Mukdahan
entries.storyHtml: The most reviewed hotel in this guide, over 1,600 reviews combined, scoring 8.4 — Riverfront Hotel Mukdahan is a 3-star boutique Mekong riverside hotel many call the best located in town, right beside the Indochina Market. It's a 6-floor building with 77 rooms, all with balconies; the front-facing Superior rooms look out to the river and the Lao bank, and breakfast is a buffet on the 6th floor with full river views. Step out of the lobby and you're at the market and the riverside promenade; TripAdvisor ranks it #1 in Mukdahan's B&B/Inn category.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: book a front-facing Superior on the 5th floor or above, since market stalls block the street-level view during the day, and check the bathroom at check-in as many are open-plan.
pros: Riverside, beside the Indochina Market — sightsee almost car-free
Front Superior rooms see the Mekong and Lao bank; all rooms have balconies
6th-floor breakfast buffet with river views, included in the rate
Spacious free parking, good value from around ฿1,000
cons: Many bathrooms are open-plan with no screen; water spreads on the floor
Market stalls block the daytime street-level view; few dinner spots nearby at night

entries.name: Vieng Khong Hotel
entries.badge: 🌅 Every room has a balcony, riverside garden
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Riverside, Samran Chai Khong Rd · large riverside garden
tags: 🌅 Every room has a riverside balcony
entries.addr: 189 Samran Chai Khong Tai Rd, Si Bun Rueang, Mueang Mukdahan
entries.storyHtml: Vieng Khong Hotel is a 3-star Mekong riverside hotel where every room has a balcony for watching the river, with a wide lawn that runs down to the water's edge. It scores 9.2 and a perfect 10/10 for location on Booking. Opened in 2015 with 37 rooms, many facing the river and the Lao bank; mornings on the balcony with coffee and a stroll through the riverside garden are the draw. With free parking and an EV charger, it suits self-drivers who want a quiet riverside base.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: request a higher-floor river-facing room at booking, since not every room faces the river head-on. The walls are thinnish, so pack earplugs if you're a light sleeper.
pros: Every room has a balcony, many with Mekong and Lao-bank views
Wide riverside garden, easy strolls in the river breeze
Breakfast buffet, free parking, and an EV charger
Great value from around ฿900 for a riverside stay
cons: Walls are on the thin side; you hear neighbours at times
Not beside the in-town markets; you'll want a car or a ride

entries.name: Ploy Palace Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre, Pitakphanomkhet Rd · walk to markets
entries.storyHtml: Ploy Palace Hotel is a 154-room 4-star hotel in the town centre that locals name first, scoring 8.8 from 34 reviews. What guests like is the central location within walking distance of markets and restaurants, the rooftop pool with a kids' pool, and a breakfast buffet with a fresh-egg station and Isan dishes. With spacious free parking it suits business and conference travellers, families bringing kids for the pool, and anyone stopping before crossing into Laos.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a renovated higher-floor room or one facing the park for better condition and a more open view, since the building has been open many years and shows its age in places.
pros: Town-centre location, walk to markets and restaurants
Rooftop pool and kids' pool, good for families
Varied breakfast with a fresh-egg station; lovely front-desk staff
Spacious free parking, handy base before crossing into Laos
cons: Building and lifts are aging; some rooms dated and the pool needs work
Not on the river; choose a riverside hotel if you want Mekong views

entries.name: Kiengpiman Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre, Damrong Mukda Rd · ~900 m to the river
tags: 🛏️ Spacious rooms, balcony in every room
entries.addr: 26 Damrong Mukda Rd, behind Municipal Market 2, Mueang Mukdahan
entries.storyHtml: Kiengpiman Hotel is a 3-star town-centre hotel praised for value and genuinely helpful staff, scoring 8.6 from 90 reviews and ranking #4 in Mukdahan on TripAdvisor. Reviewers repeatedly mention the manager who speaks fluent English and helps with visas, motorbike rental, and travel logistics. Its 60 rooms all have a balcony and a fridge, are bigger than the price suggests, and there's a front garden, free parking, and a ~900 m walk to the Indochina Market and the river.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: breakfast isn't included, but order it the night before and the hotel makes rice porridge or eggs with coffee for around ฿65. Ask the manager about visas and the border crossing at the desk.
pros: Friendly staff; English-speaking manager helps with visas and travel
Spacious, clean rooms; balcony and fridge in every room
Free parking, a front garden, and bicycle rental
Strong value on a tight budget, from around ฿700
cons: Not on the river; it's a ~900 m walk to the waterfront
Building and some fittings are aging; breakfast must be pre-ordered

entries.name: Hotel Muq
entries.badge: ✨ Opened 2021, rooms bigger than the price
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre, Chayangkul Rd · beside the bus station
tags: 🚌 Beside the bus station, town centre
entries.storyHtml: Hotel Muq is a town-centre hotel that opened in 2021, with rooms bigger than the price and everything still new and clean, scoring 8.8 from 42 reviews across 65 rooms. Guests like the spacious rooms, comfy beds, strong hot water, the breakfast buffet, and the location beside the bus station and in-town markets. It has a lift, free parking, and an EV charger, suiting bus travellers, business stays, and anyone stopping before crossing into Laos.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: request a higher floor or an inner room away from the main corridor for a quieter night, since some noise carries between rooms, and bring a mobile data backup as Wi-Fi can be weak at times.
pros: New hotel; spacious rooms, comfy beds, strong hot water, clean bathrooms
Town-centre location beside the bus station, easy to get around
Budget price, breakfast included, full lift access
Free parking and an EV charger, rare at this price
cons: Some noise carries between rooms and corridors; Wi-Fi weak in places
Small pool, not on the river, no river view from the rooms

entries.name: Bird Day Boutique Hotel
entries.badge: 🛏️ Spacious rooms, soft beds, great value
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre, Chayangkul Rd · next to Big C
tags: 🏬 Next to Big C, town centre
entries.addr: 77/99 Chayangkul Kor Rd, Mueang Mukdahan, next to Big C
entries.storyHtml: Bird Day Boutique Hotel is a small 34-room boutique hotel in the town centre with rooms bigger than the price, right next to Big C, scoring 8.7 from 21 reviews. Guests like the spacious rooms, soft beds, big bathrooms with strong hot water, breakfast included in the room (Vietnamese pho, bread, fruit), and free parking. It's styled as a boutique with a small leafy garden and a 24-hour front desk, and you can walk straight into Big C to shop.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the building has no lift, so ask for a ground-floor room if you have heavy bags (staff will help carry). Request an inner room away from the main road for quiet, and come down early for breakfast to catch the full spread.
pros: Rooms bigger than the price, soft beds, spotless and clean
Next to Big C in the town centre — shop and eat right there
Breakfast included (Vietnamese pho), free parking, fast Wi-Fi
Lovely, friendly staff who help with luggage
cons: No lift, stairs only; no pool
Not on the river; few walkable restaurants nearby outside the mall

entries.name: Nawiengkae Riverview Resort
entries.badge: 🌊 Quiet riverside, has a pool villa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Riverside, Na Si Nuan · 10–15 min drive to town
entries.addr: 183 Moo 3, Na Si Nuan, Mueang Mukdahan
entries.storyHtml: Nawiengkae Riverview Resort is a small 12-room boutique resort on the Mekong that's all about real quiet, scoring 8.4. Set in Na Si Nuan outside town, you open the balcony to the Mekong and the Lao bank, with little but the sound of water and birds. It has an outdoor pool, bicycle rental for cycling the riverbank, and a One-Bedroom Pool Villa for more privacy; the owner is warm and welcoming, making it a fit for couples and families who drive themselves.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: request a room facing the Mekong directly — the morning and sunset views are the best part. With only 12 rooms it books mainly via Facebook and phone, so confirm ahead on long weekends, and bring food with you as restaurants are far.
pros: Quiet Mekong riverside setting, made for real relaxing
Clean, spacious rooms; every room has a balcony with a view
Pool, bicycle rental, and a One-Bedroom Pool Villa
Warm, welcoming owner and staff; free parking
cons: Outside town, you need a car; ~7 km from the markets and centre
Small resort with simple facilities and limited breakfast choices

entries.name: Kim Jek Cin 2 Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Town centre, Phithak Phanomket Rd · near the provincial hall
tags: 🏙️ Town centre, near the provincial hall
entries.storyHtml: Kim Jek Cin 2 Hotel is the cheapest hotel in this guide from just ฿350, with a big free parking lot in the town centre, scoring 8.0 from 79 reviews. It's a 2-star hotel of about 30 rooms on Phithak Phanomket Road near the provincial hall, within walking reach of the Indochina Market and the Mekong. Rooms are plain and practical, clean and roomier than expected, making it a fit for budget travellers, those running errands, and anyone stopping before crossing into Laos.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for an upper-floor or corner room not sharing a wall with another to help with noise, and request a freshly cleaned room with the AC run for a while, as some rooms in the older building can smell musty.
pros: Cheapest in town, from just ฿350
Free private parking, a big lot, handy for self-drivers
Town-centre location near the provincial hall and Indochina Market
Friendly staff, 24-hour front desk
cons: Thinnish walls; you hear neighbours, and some rooms smell musty
Older building, no pool, and not on the river

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Mukdahan hotel for you

advice.head: You want a Mekong-view room on the riverfront
advice.bodyHtml: → Hotel de Ladda ฿1,400, balcony river-view rooms, marble bathrooms, top score · or Vieng Khong Hotel ฿900, a balcony in every room and a riverside garden

advice.head: You want to walk the Indochina Market and the river
advice.bodyHtml: → Riverfront Hotel Mukdahan ฿1,000, right beside the Indochina Market, most reviewed, a river-view breakfast — sightsee almost car-free

advice.head: On a tight budget, you want the best value
advice.bodyHtml: → Kim Jek Cin 2 ฿350, the cheapest in town with a big parking lot · or Hotel Muq ฿550, new, spacious, beside the bus station

advice.head: Travelling as a family, you want a pool for the kids
advice.bodyHtml: → Ploy Palace Hotel ฿1,100, a rooftop pool and kids' pool in the town centre · or Nawiengkae Riverview Resort ฿985, riverside with a pool villa

advice.head: Driving through, or crossing into Laos
advice.bodyHtml: → Hop Inn Mukdahan ฿650, clean rooms, free parking, near Friendship Bridge 2 for an easy early departure, scoring 9.6

advice.head: You want genuinely helpful, English-speaking staff
advice.bodyHtml: → Kiengpiman Hotel ฿700, an English-speaking manager who helps with visas and travel, spacious balcony rooms

advice.head: You want a quiet, private riverside stay
advice.bodyHtml: → Nawiengkae Riverview Resort ฿985, a small Mekong riverside resort in Na Si Nuan with a pool villa, best with a car

noteHtml: 📌 Note: all prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and can change by date and season. Always check live prices and compare across 3 sites before booking. Around festivals and long weekends, riverside and in-town stays fill fast and prices climb, so book ahead and lock a free-cancellation rate. Mukdahan has no metro — Grab, local taxis, or driving yourself are easiest, and many hotels offer free parking. The Indochina Market riverside and the town centre are close together, while the road up to Friendship Bridge 2 is around 7–10 minutes by car from the riverfront. faqTitle: FAQ — Common questions about Mukdahan hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Mukdahan?
faq.a: It depends on your plans. The Indochina Market riverside suits you if you want a river-view room and to walk to the market (Hotel de Ladda, Riverfront, Vieng Khong). The town centre works if you want to walk to markets and restaurants or want a pool (Ploy Palace, Kiengpiman, Hotel Muq, Bird Day, Kim Jek Cin 2). The Friendship Bridge 2 area suits drivers stopping overnight or crossing into Savannakhet (Hop Inn). Nawiengkae sits on the river in Na Si Nuan on the outskirts — very quiet, but you need a car.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Mukdahan hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: low-hundreds town-centre and budget stays start around ฿350–850/night; 3-star riverside and in-town hotels run ฿900–1,100; 4-star Mekong-riverside and town hotels run ฿1,100–1,400 and up; and a riverside pool villa is around ฿2,480. Festivals and long weekends push prices higher, so compare 3 sites and book ahead.

faq.q: ❓ Which Mukdahan hotels have Mekong-view rooms?
faq.a: Several along Samran Chai Khong Road by the river. Vieng Khong Hotel has a balcony in every room, many river-facing. Hotel de Ladda has River View rooms and Corner Suites with balconies over the Mekong toward the Lao bank. Riverfront Hotel has front-facing Superior rooms with river views and a 6th-floor breakfast over the river. Nawiengkae Riverview Resort on the outskirts has a balcony in every room. When booking, confirm a River View room, as rear or town-facing rooms are usually cheaper but lack the view.

faq.q: ❓ Crossing into Savannakhet — where should I stay?
faq.a: Friendship Bridge 2 is about 10 km from town. If you're driving and want an early departure, Hop Inn Mukdahan sits on the bypass road closest to the bridge, with clean rooms and free parking. If you'd rather sleep in the centre near the markets and then drive to the border, Ploy Palace, Hotel Muq, or Bird Day are about 10–15 minutes from the checkpoint.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Mukdahan hotel?
faq.a: On regular weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. But during festivals and long weekends, and when there's an event or conference in town, riverside and in-town stays fill fast and prices climb — book several weeks ahead and lock a free-cancellation rate, especially the small Nawiengkae resort with only 12 rooms.

faq.q: ❓ Do Mukdahan hotels have free parking?
faq.a: Most do. Mukdahan is a town where people like to drive themselves, and almost every hotel here offers free parking — including Hotel de Ladda, Riverfront, Vieng Khong (with an EV charger), Ploy Palace, Kiengpiman, Hotel Muq (with an EV charger), Bird Day, Hop Inn, and Kim Jek Cin 2 (a big lot). There's no metro, but Grab and local taxis are easy too.
